dialogues.jp:
昼休憩になって、外へ買い物に行こうと、校門
に向かった。
dialogues.en:
My destination was beyond the school gates, to buy some
stuff.
dialogues.text:
My destination was beyond the school gates, to buy some
stuff.

dialogues.jp: すると、そこには月城がいた。
dialogues.en: Right at the school gates, I unexpectedly saw Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: Right at the school gates, I unexpectedly saw Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp: 「月城ー。月城も、外へ買い物に行くのか？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro! Are you heading out to do shopping too?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro! Are you heading out to do shopping too?"

dialogues.jp: 俺のことに気が付いた月城がこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Noticing me, she nodded in answer to my question.
dialogues.text: Noticing me, she nodded in answer to my question.

dialogues.jp: 「珍しいよな、こんなところで会うなんて」
dialogues.en: "Heh, it's odd to meet you here."
dialogues.text: "Heh, it's odd to meet you here."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、指先で『一緒に行こう』と促し、学校の
外へ歩き出す。
dialogues.en:
I pointed out the school gates, indirectly suggesting "let's
go together", and started off.
dialogues.text:
I pointed out the school gates, indirectly suggesting "let's
go together", and started off.

dialogues.jp: 月城もその後ろから、トコトコとついてくる。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro calmly followed behind me.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro calmly followed behind me.

dialogues.jp: 「昼飯でも買いに出るのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you buying lunch?"
dialogues.text: "Are you buying lunch?"

dialogues.jp: もぞもぞと抱いている人形を手に持ち、
dialogues.en: The gloves came off once again, and after a few pats;
dialogues.text: The gloves came off once again, and after a few pats;

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、アリスは午後の授業のノートを買い
　にいくだけだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Nope, Alice is looking for notebooks for the afternoon
classes."
dialogues.text:
"Nope, Alice is looking for notebooks for the afternoon
classes."

dialogues.jp:
人形で話をしていることは、特に追及すること
はないだろう。
dialogues.en: Getting that doll to talk won't solve anything.
dialogues.text: Getting that doll to talk won't solve anything.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、たぶんこういうスタンスでしか人と話
ができないんだろう。
dialogues.en:
As long as Tsukishiro keeps up this stance, she won't ever
get used to talking to people.
dialogues.text:
As long as Tsukishiro keeps up this stance, she won't ever
get used to talking to people.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城と話をしていて、そう思った。
dialogues.en: I want to get her to talk to me, somehow.
dialogues.text: I want to get her to talk to me, somehow.

dialogues.jp: 「ノートなら、購買にもあるんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Can't you just buy that at the school's stationery shop?"
dialogues.text: "Can't you just buy that at the school's stationery shop?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「アリスが使ってるのは、学校には置いてない
　んだ。だから、外に買いに行くしかないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"The ones Alice uses can't be bought at school. We have no
choice but to go out to get it."
dialogues.text:
"The ones Alice uses can't be bought at school. We have no
choice but to go out to get it."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「大変なんだな。ノートなんて、どれも同じに
　見えるがね」
dialogues.en: "That's odd. Notebooks all look the same to me."
dialogues.text: "That's odd. Notebooks all look the same to me."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「アレじゃないと……、ダメ」
dialogues.en: "That... isn't true."
dialogues.text: "That... isn't true."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「えっ、ああ、うん、そうなのか……。そうだ
　よな」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ahh, yeah... of course."
dialogues.text: "Eh, ahh, yeah... of course."

dialogues.jp:
突然、口を開いた月城に、思わず驚いてしまい、
そんな生返事を返してしまった。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly opening her mouth like that, I could only force out
a vague, stammered reply.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly opening her mouth like that, I could only force out
a vague, stammered reply.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩は、なにかこだわってるものはないの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you worried about something, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "Are you worried about something, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「こだわり、なぁ。別にないな」
dialogues.en: "Worried? Ehh, not really."
dialogues.text: "Worried? Ehh, not really."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「──ふうん」

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ふうん、ってなんでそんなにがっかりしたよ
　うな反応なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Is that weird?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Is that weird?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩は、もっと変わった人だと思ってた
　から……」
dialogues.en: "We thought you'd be kinda different than you are now..."
dialogues.text: "We thought you'd be kinda different than you are now..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「変わった人だと？」
dialogues.en: "Different?"
dialogues.text: "Different?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、去年のクリスマスパーティーとか、卒
　業パーティーとか」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, like how you were during last year's Christmas and
graduation parties."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, like how you were during last year's Christmas and
graduation parties."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……有名なのか」
dialogues.en: "...I'm famous, huh."
dialogues.text: "...I'm famous, huh."

dialogues.jp:
ウチの学校は、なぜか学生参加型の年間行事が
多く、クリスマスパーティーと卒業パーティー
もそのうちのひとつだった。
dialogues.en:
This school has a lot of yearly events that students have to
participate in, such as the Christmas and graduation
parties.
dialogues.text:
This school has a lot of yearly events that students have to
participate in, such as the Christmas and graduation
parties.

dialogues.jp:
去年のそれらで、俺は裏でいろいろお茶目をやっ
ていたのだ。
dialogues.en:
I ended up being involved in a lot of mischief at those
functions last year.
dialogues.text:
I ended up being involved in a lot of mischief at those
functions last year.

dialogues.jp:
杉並も含め、すっかり風紀委員のブラックリス
トに載ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Along with Suginami, I was quickly placed on the discplinary
committee's blacklist.
dialogues.text:
Along with Suginami, I was quickly placed on the discplinary
committee's blacklist.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、さすがに今年からは自分も卒業というこ
ともあり、何もすまいと思っているのだが。
dialogues.en:
Well, I guess this year being the one I graduate myself, has
made me mellow down a bit.
dialogues.text:
Well, I guess this year being the one I graduate myself, has
made me mellow down a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「割と、知ってる人は多いんじゃないかな」
dialogues.en: "Everyone's heard of your exploits."
dialogues.text: "Everyone's heard of your exploits."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「月城も、俺のことを知ってた？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro, you know about me too?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro, you know about me too?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……少しだけ」
dialogues.en: "...A little."
dialogues.text: "...A little."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「まさか、俺がそんなに有名人だったとは」
dialogues.en: "Wow, I'm really that famous..."
dialogues.text: "Wow, I'm really that famous..."

dialogues.jp:
どういう噂かわからないけれど、後輩にまで自
分の名前が知れ渡っているとなると、なんだか
嬉しいな。
dialogues.en:
I don't normally partake in gossping, but to hear that even
the lowerclassmen know my name, gives me a sense of pride.
dialogues.text:
I don't normally partake in gossping, but to hear that even
the lowerclassmen know my name, gives me a sense of pride.

dialogues.jp:
思わず、鼻がにゅーっと伸びてしまいそうな気
持ちだ。
dialogues.en: I could practically feel my head getting bigger.
dialogues.text: I could practically feel my head getting bigger.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「白河先生や、他の先生とかがよく言ってるよ。
　『３年の朝倉や杉並みたいにはなるな』って」
dialogues.en:
"Shirakawa-sensei and the other senseis talk about you
often, saying things like "Don't be like Asakura and
Suginami from 3rd year"."
dialogues.text:
"Shirakawa-sensei and the other senseis talk about you
often, saying things like "Don't be like Asakura and
Suginami from 3rd year"."

dialogues.jp:
あいつら……人のいないところで、なんてこと
を……。
dialogues.en: Those people... talking like that about me behind my back...
dialogues.text: Those people... talking like that about me behind my back...

dialogues.jp:
新聞に載ってやるぞ？　『某学園生、教師への
不信感から、登校拒否！』マスコミに自分でネ
タをばらまいてやる。
dialogues.en:
Wait till they see the newspapers tomorrow... "Student
refuses to go to school!", how good that'd look.
dialogues.text:
Wait till they see the newspapers tomorrow... "Student
refuses to go to school!", how good that'd look.

dialogues.jp: 「それにしても、今日はよく喋るじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "You're sure talking a lot today, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "You're sure talking a lot today, aren't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ボク？　んー、でもボクはアリスの気持ちを
　代弁してるだけだから」
dialogues.en:
"Me? Mm, but that's because I'm basically a proxy for Alice
trying to communicate her feelings."
dialogues.text:
"Me? Mm, but that's because I'm basically a proxy for Alice
trying to communicate her feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、月城がお喋りしたいってことになる
　のか？」
dialogues.en: "Then, Tsukishiro, you like to chit-chat?"
dialogues.text: "Then, Tsukishiro, you like to chit-chat?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Not really."
dialogues.text: "...Not really."

dialogues.jp: わけわかんねぇ……。
dialogues.en: Incomprehensible...
dialogues.text: Incomprehensible...

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、いいや。ノート買いに行くっつったら、
　表通りの文房具屋だろ？　俺もそこに用事が
　あるから、一緒に行こうぜ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, whatever. I know a good stationery shop at the main
street... I have stuff to do there, shall we go together?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, whatever. I know a good stationery shop at the main
street... I have stuff to do there, shall we go together?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「うん、たまには……いいかな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that sounds... good."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that sounds... good."

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、どちらにも嫌われてはいないようだ
が、好かれてるかと言われると、それはどうだ
かわからない。
dialogues.en:
Doesn't seem like they dislike the idea, but in the same
vein, I can't really tell whether they enjoy it either.
dialogues.text:
Doesn't seem like they dislike the idea, but in the same
vein, I can't really tell whether they enjoy it either.

dialogues.jp: ま、こういう知り合いもたまにはいいだろう。
dialogues.en: Well, at least getting this far is good enough.
dialogues.text: Well, at least getting this far is good enough.

dialogues.jp: ◆代弁者◆
dialogues.en: ◆Spokesperson◆
dialogues.text: ◆Spokesperson◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休憩になり、外へ買い物へ行こうとすると、
月城に出会った。
dialogues.en:
While heading out to do some shopping during lunch break, I
ran into Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
While heading out to do some shopping during lunch break, I
ran into Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
俺が話しかけると、月城は人形を使って、返事
をしてくれた。
dialogues.en:
At my attempts to start conversation, Tsukishiro once again
used the doll to answer for her.
dialogues.text:
At my attempts to start conversation, Tsukishiro once again
used the doll to answer for her.

dialogues.jp:
なぜだか、今日に限って、人形はよく喋り、そ
のことを｛き／訊｝くと『アリスの気持ちを代弁してい
るだけ』と答えるのだった。
dialogues.en:
The limit of what I could find out, was that the doll was
"Alice's proxy in trying to communicate her feelings."
dialogues.text:
The limit of what I could find out, was that the doll was
"Alice's proxy in trying to communicate her feelings."

dialogues.jp:
ただ、月城本人に訊くと、別に喋りたい、とい
う訳ではないらしい。
dialogues.en:
But when I asked her herself, she said she didn't
particularly want to talk.
dialogues.text:
But when I asked her herself, she said she didn't
particularly want to talk.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、よくはわからないが、とりあえずは嫌わ
れていないということだろう。
dialogues.en:
Well, I don't understand at all, but it's not something I
can't stand, at least.
dialogues.text:
Well, I don't understand at all, but it's not something I
can't stand, at least.
